verses.text: A psalm of thanks. Shout for joy to the LORD, everyone on earth!
Serve the LORD with joy. Come into his presence singing!
Know that the LORD is God. He made us, and we belong to him. We’re his people, the sheep he looks after.
Walk through his gates giving thanks. Come into his courts with praise. Thank him and bless his name.
The LORD is good. His faithful love lasts forever, and he stays faithful through every generation.
